mechanism_narrative: The federal funds rate at 0.2% represents a historically low level that compresses discount rates and increases equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS at or below 0.25% occurs in more than 30% of instances but 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of those cases.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 9.5% signals weak consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE > 9.5 occurs in more than 20% of instances but 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of those cases.

mechanism_narrative: The joint condition of FEDFUNDS < 0.5% and CPIAUCSL < 220 signals a low-inflation, low-rate environment that supports equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition occurs in more than 25% of instances but 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of those cases.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 9.5%), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns due to reduced consumer confidence and corporate investment.
failure_condition: The regime condition (UNRATE > 9.5) occurs in more than 20% of instances but 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of those cases.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 650 signal weak housing market conditions that trigger monetary policy easing expectations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST < 650 occurs in more than 20% of instances but 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of those cases.

mechanism_narrative: The joint condition of INDPRO < 100 and HOUST < 650 signals near-term economic slowdown, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as investors seek safe havens.
failure_condition: The joint condition occurs in more than 15% of instances but 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of those cases.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 100 signals economic weakness that triggers market anticipation of central bank policy response, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 100 occurs in more than 20% of instances but 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of those cases.

mechanism_narrative: In low inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL < 220), the Federal Reserve maintains accommodative monetary policy that supports equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL < 220 occurs in more than 20% of instances but 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of those cases.
